Hi Steve, my name's Amira and I'll be training you during your first week at Cine Theatre 8.
Thanks, I'm excited to get started.
We're going to begin in the box office where I'll show you how to print the movie tickets and use the register.
Okay, do we use the same type of register in the concession stand?
It's a little different.
We use tablets with touchscreens in the concession stand so we can easily tap on the beverages or snacks being purchased.
Since we have a lot of different snacks, this is useful when lines are long.

谢谢，我很期待开始工作。
我们将在票务处开始，我会教您如何打印电影票和使用收银机。
好的，我们在小吃店用的是同类型的收银机吗？
有点不同。
我们在小吃店使用的是触摸屏平板电脑，这样我们可以轻松地点击购买的饮料或零食。
因为我们有很多不同的零食，当排队人多时这一点很有用。
